title: Seal with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9fb8c9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5f7f96'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bellyGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f1f6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b9cdd9'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='82' rx='13' ry='7' fill='#4d6a80' transform='rotate(-25 26 82)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='82' rx='13' ry='7' fill='#4d6a80' transform='rotate(25 74 82)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='30' ry='22' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='18' ry='15' fill='url(#bellyGrad)'/>
  <!-- side flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='19' cy='62' rx='6' ry='13' fill='#527089' transform='rotate(20 19 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='81' cy='62' rx='6' ry='13' fill='#527089' transform='rotate(-20 81 62)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='23' ry='20' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='13' ry='8' fill='#c4d6e0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38.5' rx='4.5' ry='3.2' fill='#2f4a5e'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.8' cy='37.4' rx='1.6' ry='1' fill='#8fb0c4'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 42 Q45.5 46.5 41.5 43.5' stroke='#2f4a5e' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 42 Q54.5 46.5 58.5 43.5' stroke='#2f4a5e' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='41' r='0.9' fill='#6d8ba0'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='44' r='0.9' fill='#6d8ba0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='41' r='0.9' fill='#6d8ba0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='44' r='0.9' fill='#6d8ba0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='32' rx='6' ry='6.5' fill='#1d2b38'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='32' rx='6' ry='6.5' fill='#1d2b38'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='32' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#5fd0e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='32' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#5fd0e8'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='38.3' cy='30' r='1.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.3' cy='30' r='1.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='34.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='34.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M36 28 L37 30.5 L39.5 31 L37.2 32.5 L37.7 35 L36 33.3 L34.3 35 L34.8 32.5 L32.5 31 L35 30.5 Z' fill='#eaffff' opacity='0.9' transform='translate(-2 -3)'/>
  <path d='M64 28 L65 30.5 L67.5 31 L65.2 32.5 L65.7 35 L64 33.3 L62.3 35 L62.8 32.5 L60.5 31 L63 30.5 Z' fill='#eaffff' opacity='0.9' transform='translate(2 -3)'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='39' r='3.2' fill='#e88fa6' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='39' r='3.2' fill='#e88fa6' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- eyebrow highlights on head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='21' rx='9' ry='3' fill='#b6ccda' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
